entries.description: Interactive Starry Night Painting Explorer — clickable hotspots with technique details, symbolism, and Van Gogh quotes
changes: Added PaintingExplorer.astro component with 5 interactive hotspot zones (Cypress, Moon, Stars, Village, Hills)
Detail panels with symbolism, technique breakdowns, and Van Gogh quotes for each element
Zoom controls (1x-3x) with drag-to-pan and pinch-to-zoom on mobile
Quick-nav pills for fast access to each hotspot
Responsive layout with mobile-optimized touch interactions
Keyboard support: Escape to close detail panel

entries.description: Painting Explorer v2 — full implementation with 10 hotspots, zoom/pan, and side panel
changes: Created src/content/painting-explorer.json with 10 hotspot definitions (cypress, moon, stars, sky swirls, village, church spire, rolling hills, tree line, foreground)
Created src/components/PaintingExplorer.astro with hotspot rendering, pulsing dot animations, and slide-in side panel
Created public/js/painting-explorer.js with zoom (1x-3x), mouse wheel zoom, drag-to-pan, pinch-to-zoom on mobile
Added painting explorer section to index.astro between painting reveal and changelog
Side panel shows element name, description, technique badge, and Van Gogh quote
Keyboard accessible: Tab navigates hotspots, Enter activates, Escape closes panel
Respects prefers-reduced-motion for hotspot pulsing animation
Progressive image loading from Wikimedia Commons (small → large srcset)
12 unit tests passing
